789-1531-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-1531-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

512-1432-4188.easyPrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
512-1432-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1432-4188.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Accomplished Alchemist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-4314--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4247-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4247-4302-5929.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

394-586-864-2438-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-2438-3125.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2738-4556-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1494-2230-5256-5662.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in your graveyard.
1494-2230-5256-5662.description:
Cast Polukranos Unchained from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {4}{B}{G} and exiling six other cards from your graveyard, causing it to enter the battlefield with twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Polukranos Unchained.
When Polukranos Unchained dies, Reyhan triggers, putting twelve +1/+1 counters onto Sage of Hours.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Polukranos Unchained's power.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat every second extra turn until you run out of cards to pay the escape cost.

4399-4476-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4476-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

862-2997-3558-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-2997-3558-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

670-1619-6145-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6145-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Passageway Seer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Passageway Seer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

2500-3609-7752--121.easyPrerequisites: Creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
2500-3609-7752--121.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of the Spacecraft until end of turn
Activate Mirage Mirror by tapping a creature with power 3 or greater, putting at least three charge counters on it.
During your next turn, activate Mirage Mirror twice by paying {4}, with the first ability targeting the Spacecraft and the second ability targeting Magistrate's Scepter.
Resolve the first ability, causing Mirage Mirror to become a copy of Magistrate's Scepter until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Mirage Mirror's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Mirage Mirror ability from step 3, causing it to become a copy of the Spacecraft until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
2500-3609-7752--121.notes: If the creature(s) tapped has power 4 or greater, you may be able to bypass causing Mirage Mirror to become a copy of the Spacecraft. This can be done as long as Mirage Mirror has six or more charge counters on it before starting step 3. The chosen Spacecraft must become a creature to avoid the legend rule, as dictated by Council of Reeds.

240-719-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-3967.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

3967-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2511-3440-4867-6809.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice and Scion of Opulence triggers once.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 3.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2829-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3168-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2292-3168-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-3168-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

632-955-3621-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-955-3621-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

3591-5436-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
3591-5436-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
3591-5436-5796-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

1429-2018-3698.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Lesser Masticore didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
If Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield in step 3, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.
If Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield in step 5, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

967-2511-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

765-804-1479.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2757-4365-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

413-1339-3284.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-1339-3284.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

877-997-4254-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
877-997-4254-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3663-4772-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3663-4772-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Three Blind Mice from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies in addition to their other types.
The Three Blind Mice tokens enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to Doubling Season, triggering their first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice triggers, creating four 1/1 Mouse creature tokens.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating two token copies of a Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite Three Blind Mice triggers, you may use them to copy any token(s) you control.

1132-1462-1594-2557-4761.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {W}{U}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1797-2034-4067-5003.notablePrerequisites:
At least two creatures have died this turn.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1797-2034-4067-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar Altar by sacrificing Inga, adding {C}{C}.
When Inga dies, it's second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Inga trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Inga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Inga enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to scry 3.
Repeat.

224-872-1525-1644.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
224-872-1525-1644.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tatyova and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Resolve the Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1722-2034-4691-5213.notablePrerequisites:
Trespasser's Curse attached to you.
You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-4691-5213.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Trespasser's Curse.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Trespasser's Curse trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2304-2450-4872.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling an instant or sorcery at random from your graveyard, and casting a copy of Time Warp without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning Whim of Volrath to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1452-1561.notablePrerequisites:
The opponent chosen with Black Vise has at least four cards in their hand.
The opponent chosen with Black Vise has a library size which is larger than their life total.
1452-1561.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing the opponent named by Black Vise to draw half their library and lose half their life, rounded up.
At the beginning of that opponent's next upkeep, Black Vise triggers, dealing damage to the named opponent equal to the number of cards in their hand minus four.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

719-4050-4338.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
